title: Add new release repository picknik_controllers-release
author: moriarty
body:
* Name of the release team: picknik
  * https://github.com/ros2-gbp/ros2-gbp-github-org/pull/281
  * Issue #280 

* Release repositories to add:
  <!--
  Before release repositories are created, repositories and packages should be submitted to the official rosdistro repository https://github.com/ros/rosdistro for naming review.
  The ros/rosdistro source entry link must be included for each repository.
  Guidelines for package naming are describe in REP-144: https://www.ros.org/reps/rep-0144.html

  If there are any existing release repositories which should have their contents imported into the ros2-gbp organization, list and link to them here.
  Leave the checkbox _unchecked_. The ros2-gbp administrator will check the box when they have completed the repository import.
  -->
  * [picknik_controllers](https://github.com/PickNikRobotics/picknik_controllers)
    * ros/rosdistro source entry: https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/pull/37736
    * [ ] There is an existing release repository which should be imported: <RELEASE REPOSITORY URL>

The https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/pull/37736 hasn't been merged yet but I'm opening this issue early assuming there are no naming issues.

comments.author: nuclearsandwich
comments.body:
> assuming there are no naming issues.

Opening the issue early is definitely welcome. I would still block release repository creation on approval of the REP-144 naming in particular since if they don't pass those review the release repository name is likely to change. In this case, I went ahead and did the source entry review as a prerequisite to approving this PR.

comments.author: nuclearsandwich
comments.body: In case I get lost today, the deployment of this PR was delayed because I hit the 5000 request rate limit after a few successive terraform plans. I should be updating within an hour confirming successful deployment but it's possible (given that it's Saturday) that time will get away from me while waiting.
